scope: Complete pronunciation-assessment systems: a packaged system (library, app or API) that takes a recording and the text that was read and returns scores at sound, word and sentence level.

pronunciada-fp32.label: Pronunciada 1.0.2 (main), fp32 backbone (default)
pronunciada-fp32.version: 1.0.2, repository main at fce7918; package fingerprint 6b418b1526ff946d
pronunciada-fp32.licence_weights: ZIPA-small backbone CC BY 4.0; Pronunciada's own heads Apache-2.0
pronunciada-fp32.given: recording + prompt text (the library's own text front end makes the phones)

score_used.sound: sound model regression output (0-2) for Pearson; 1 - P(correct) at strictness 0.5 for marked-sound detection
score_used.sentence: SentenceResult.scores total / accuracy / fluency / prosodic; the suite's sentence score is scores["total"]
score_used.OMPAL word: min WordResult.prob over the words covering the character

pronunciada-fp32.run: bench.learnerbench.run_pronunciada --variant fp32, 3 worker processes x 1 ONNX thread

openpronounce-1.1.0.label: OpenPronounce 1.1.0, default mode
openpronounce-1.1.0.version: 1.1.0 (latest release on PyPI and GitHub on 2026-11-23; tag v1.1.0 = bd51333); installed from the PyPI wheel (sha256 10eb00eeb94a3f0050619414f6bfc9160205f8bee83013ace723719ff830dd80) in its own virtualenv, never imported into Pronunciada's
openpronounce-1.1.0.licence_weights: facebook/wav2vec2-lv-60-espeak-cv-ft @ ae45363 Apache-2.0; facebook/wav2vec2-large-960h @ bdeaacd Apache-2.0 (English transcript); jonatasgrosman/wav2vec2-large-xlsr-53-spanish @ 96d7e9b and -german @ 4b8a029 Apache-2.0 (transcript, non-English default mode); Piper voices rhasspy/piper-voices @ e9c8a39 (offline reference voice, used instead of the online gTTS default); scoring models shipped in the package (AGPL)

score_used.sound: 100 (1 - p), p = its phone model's probability that the expected sound is wrong, aligned to Pronunciada's reference sounds (bench.rivals.convert.to_reference)
score_used.sentence: `score` (= scores["total"]) and scores accuracy / fluency / prosodic

openpronounce-1.1.0.run: bench.rivals.openpronounce --mode default, CPU, 4 torch threads, offline (Piper voice, network blocked in the worker)

openpronounce-1.1.0-student.label: OpenPronounce 1.1.0 with its distilled English phone model
openpronounce-1.1.0-student.version: 1.1.0 with OPENPRONOUNCE_PHONEME_MODEL=OpenPronounce/wav2vec2-base-phones-en @ 2e12ec2, --fast (the setting its model card documents)

azure.label: Azure Pronunciation Assessment (cached responses)
azure.version: REST API, region westus; speechocean762 / L2-ARCTIC / EpaDB / OMPAL responses obtained 2026-11 for the scoreboard; Heroico and Speech Accent Archive responses obtained 2026-11-22 (round 19). No request was made in this benchmark.

languages_of_suite.de: supported, not run (no cached responses for LeaP)

score_used.sentence: PronScore (suite); Accuracy / Fluency / Prosody / PronScore (speechocean762 aspects); AccuracyScore (OMPAL)

lingolix.label: Lingolix pronunciation API (cached responses)
lingolix.version: POST /api/pronunciation/v3/check, model_version 2026-11; speechocean762 test responses obtained 2026-11-22. No request was made in this benchmark.
